title: The CCPA Deletion Request You Can't Fill
summary: CCPA deletion requests expose where data really lives. For California firms in 2026, privacy compliance is an access control and AI governance problem.
caption:
A verified deletion request is the most honest audit your company will ever receive.

It does not read your privacy policy. The question is where one person's data actually lives — across file shares, CRM records, HR folders, ticket histories, archived mailboxes and whatever a SaaS tool copied two years ago.

Most California companies can answer that for their website. Far fewer can answer it for their own employees, whose records now sit in the same systems an AI assistant indexes.

The 2026 version of privacy compliance is retention design, access control and knowing which systems hold what. Our new essay argues the gap between your stated posture and your real one is measured in minutes.
